title: Cells in a Range on an Excel Sheet
description:
[Source: LeetCode 2194]
A cell (r, c) of an excel sheet is represented as a string "<col><row>". Given a string s in the format "<col1><row1>:<col2><row2>", return the list of cells (<col><row>) such that cells are represented in sorted order.

Input Format:
Range string s

Output Format:
Space-separated list of cells

testcases.output: A1 B1 C1 D1 E1 F1
